payload.storyArc: On 29 October Ukraine said limits on US intelligence sharing were costing lives. A day later Washington confirmed a partial pause.
payload.trajectory: Expect talks between Kyiv and Washington over the next two weeks; the most likely outcome is a partial restoration.
payload.rootCauseChain: The immediate trigger was the pause; behind it sits a wider US review of aid; deeper still, a shift in US priorities.
watchQuestions: Will the US restore full targeting data before the November aid review?
Will European partners offer replacement intelligence?
Will Kyiv change its front-line posture?
